successors.name: Dutch East Indies
successors.text: Kutai, where in 1844 'the Dutch defeated the sultan, forced him into exile, and took direct control of Kutai' (Cliopatria outline plus the Muara Kaman disc, as in the keyframes)

ledger.x: 1300: Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti founds Kutai Kartanegara at Kutai Lama. the Sultanate page's lead has the sultanate originating 'from the Hindu Kingdom of Martapura founded in 1300 at Kutai Lama' and its body says Kutai Kartanegara 'was founded in the 14th century in the area of Kutai Lama', with the first ruler…

1635: the united realm is called Kutai Kartanegara ing Martadipura. the two realms merged into 'Kutai Kartanegara Ing Martadipura'; the Sultanate page says Kutai Kartanegara annexed Martapura and renamed it.
1732: the capital moves from Kutai Lama to Jembayan.
1782: the capital moves to Tepian Pandan (Tenggarong).
1844: the Dutch defeat the sultan and take Kutai.

1844: the sovereign sultanate of Kutai Kartanegara ends under Dutch control; the Sultanate page has the sultanate continuing as a Dutch vassal with internal autonomy (Sultan Aji Muhammad Sulaiman, 1845-1899), and as a special region after 1945 until 1960.

wars.name: Kutai Kartanegara conquest of Kutai Martapura
wars.outcome: Kutai Kartanegara wins; Martapura is annexed and the realm becomes Kutai Kartanegara ing Martadipura.

wars.name: Dutch conquest of Kutai (1844)
wars.outcome: The Dutch defeat the sultan after the repulse of Murray's expedition and take direct control of Kutai.

certainty.note: River-based frontiers of a Mahakam polity; neither page gives a boundary, the extent in every era is approximate.
